thread:
kai: Quick async update — what I did / blockers / today:

kai: What I did: shifted 6 prewarm GPUs from us-central -> asia-southeast to cover yesterday's APAC surge, drained 2 eu-west1 nodes for maintenance, kicked off a small canary of the new autoscaler config.

kai: Blockers: quota bump (CR-7891) still pending with cloud team, seeing intermittent spot evictions on the g4 pool, observed ~12% token-per-second dip while KV caches rehydrate.

kai: Today: will run cache warmups, follow up on quota escalation, open a tiny autoscaler tweak PR to reduce burst costs in eu-west.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the node labels you used? Need to remap lane ownership for billing.

kai: labels: `lane=tilt-2026-03` and `capacity=prewarm`. Commands I used: `gcloud compute instances stop <instance> --zone=us-central1-a` then `kubectl cordon <node>` and `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

tom: I reviewed CR-7891 and approved staging changes, but quota approval is still in the cloud console. Pinged quota@cloud and linked the traffic spike graph.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: Escalating now — opened ticket CLOUD-5421 with support. ETA 1.5-2h for quota decision. If APAC keeps ramping, we should flip fallback to eu-west for latency-critical routes.

lee: Noted the latency bump — seeing 140ms median on small models during the node handoffs (normally 120ms). Likely KV cache warmup as Kai said. Do we want to run targeted warmups for the 3 busiest pods?

kai: Plan: run `redwood-client warmup --model=gpt-medium --iters=50 --parallel=10` across the newly attached nodes — starting in ~15m. That should bring latency back under 125ms.

infra-bot: Deploybot: canary rollout `autoscaler-v2` triggered by @kai — status: 3/10 succeeded, 7 pending. CI link: https://ci.internal/reports/1234 (job 578).

maria: I'll open the PR to set `maxSurge: 1` for eu-west and add the `prewarm` lane exemption so we avoid big bursts there. Small change, should be low-risk.

tom: FYI — I've added a tiny metric alert: `gpu.node.evictions > 5m` to the ops dashboard, threshold tuned to avoid noise.

ops-oncall: If we get another eviction wave, I'll flip the routing policy to `fallback_region: eu-west` and enable a temporary reserved pool. Will update CLOUD-5421.

kai: Action items: 1) ops-oncall escalate quota (ops-oncall) 2) kai run warmups (me) 3) maria PR to reduce surge (maria) 4) lee monitor latency and confirm warmup effect (lee) 5) tom keep the eviction alert tuned (tom). I'll post a status in 1h. :thumbsup:

maria: acked.

lee: ack, will watch latency dash and post if 95p stays > 250ms.

kai: thanks — will update thread after warmups and quota reply.
